name: Section of E65 by Toarp
description: A random 1.3 km of the E65 motorway south of Malmö: a European road reads as signed (E65, not OSM's "E 65"). OSM: both ends are nearest the village Toarp (1.1 and 1.4 km); the town Oxie 1.8 km from the west end is bigger but not twice as near as a village needs to beat it by, and the hamlet Skabersjöby 1.1 km from the east end loses to the village only 1.4 km away.
